## What Devsignpro does

Devsignpro builds high-performance websites and digital systems for startups and businesses, with a strong focus on:

1. Custom website development (Next.js, React, TypeScript)
2. Business automation, custom dashboards, and AI integrations
3. E-commerce website development
4. Technical SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)

Sites are engineered for Core Web Vitals, Google Search visibility, and citation in AI answer engines such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews / Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Grok.
